steps.intro: Open Snapchat → your profile → Public Profile → Insights. Set the range to Last 28 Days. Then screenshot:
steps.publicStories: Public Stories — the 28 Day Summary (Snap Views, Viewers, view times)
steps.spotlight: Spotlight — the 28 Day Summary (Views, Viewers, Favourites, Shares)
steps.note: Make sure the numbers aren't cut off — you can add more than one image per screen.

monthly.periodHint: Shown on the report — a month or a date range (e.g. 25 May – 21 Jun)
monthly.needImages: Add at least one screenshot to a slot

steps.one: Open Snapchat → your profile → tap the story you posted for the brand.
steps.two: Tap the frame that featured the brand — its Insights appear (Views, Viewers, Screenshots, Clicks).
steps.three: Screenshot it. If the brand appeared in several frames, screenshot each one.
steps.four: Upload them within ~24 hours, before Snapchat hides the story's numbers.
steps.note: Only screenshot the frames that were the ad — not every frame.
